episodes.title: GPT-6.1 Terra, Anthropic S-1, Grok Bot chief of staff
episodes.dek: OpenAI ships Terra computer use. Anthropic files for IPO. Elon on Grok Bot. Nvidia cancer risk tool.

sections.headline: Tuesday morning roundup
sections.dek: The last twenty-four hours in AI and space.
paragraphs: Good morning. This is Leo Ward with Good Morning AI. Tuesday, October twenty-seventh. The last twenty-four hours brought significant moves from the major AI labs.

sections.headline: Grok Bot as chief of staff; no launch
sections.dek: Elon highlights weekly features. SpaceX quiet.
paragraphs: SpaceX had no new posts overnight. No launch in the window. On the xAI side, Elon Musk highlighted Grok Bot, describing it as like hiring an incredibly competent chief of staff. He noted that over one hundred features and fixes are released every week, and asked followers what the most important things to improve about Grok Bot are.

sections.headline: S-1 IPO filing and nonprofit expansion
sections.dek: Registration statement filed. Claude for Nonprofits grows.
paragraphs: Anthropic filed an S-1 registration statement with the SEC related to its proposed IPO. Separately, they expanded Claude for Nonprofits. More than twenty-five thousand nonprofits now use Claude, most small local teams, and they added a plugin built with around thirty of them for skills in fundraising, marketing, and hiring.

sections.headline: GPT-6.1 Terra computer use at lower price
sections.dek: Fast capable agents. Available to Plus, Pro and more.
paragraphs: OpenAI released GPT-6.1 Terra. It delivers fast and capable computer use at a lower price. The model understands what is on screen, takes action across apps, writes naturally, and is available now to all Plus, Pro, Enterprise, and Edu users in ChatGPT Work and Codex, plus via the API. It substantially outperforms previous versions on agent tests and runs cheaper and faster.

sections.headline: AI estimates breast cancer recurrence risk
sections.dek: SimBioSys TumorSight Risk powered by NVIDIA.
paragraphs: Nvidia highlighted work with SimBioSys. Powered by NVIDIA technology, its FDA-cleared TumorSight Risk analyzes an existing breast MRI alongside pathology and clinical information to estimate the risk of cancer returning at five and ten years, helping doctors and patients with treatment decisions before surgery.

sections.headline: Quiet on AI fronts
paragraphs: Google was quiet on major AI fronts overnight. Their posts stayed light-hearted rather than covering new model or research drops.

sections.headline: Overnight picture
paragraphs: That is the overnight picture. Product releases, an IPO filing, and healthcare applications. Have a good day.

episodes.title: Super Heavy static fire; labs quiet overnight
episodes.dek: 33-engine Super Heavy static fire for Flight 15. Anthropic, OpenAI, Google quiet. Nvidia GTC Berlin highlights.

sections.headline: Monday morning roundup
sections.dek: The last twenty-four hours in AI and space.
paragraphs: Good morning. This is Leo Ward with Good Morning AI. Monday, October twenty-sixth. The last twenty-four hours were relatively quiet across the major AI labs, with one clear standout from SpaceX.

sections.headline: Full-duration 33-engine Super Heavy static fire
sections.dek: Preparing for Starship Flight 15. No new xAI product drop.
paragraphs: SpaceX completed a full-duration thirty-three engine static fire of the Super Heavy booster preparing for Starship Flight fifteen. Elon Musk shared the video and simply noted Starship Flight fifteen static fire. No new xAI model or product announcements in the window.

sections.headline: Quiet overnight
sections.dek: No new posts or announcements in the window.
paragraphs: Anthropic was quiet overnight. No new posts or announcements from the official accounts in the last twenty-four hours.

sections.headline: Quiet overnight
sections.dek: No new posts from OpenAI accounts.
paragraphs: OpenAI was also quiet. No new posts from the official OpenAI accounts overnight.

sections.headline: GTC Berlin highlights for Europe AI
sections.dek: Jensen on AI factories, agents, robotics and healthcare.
paragraphs: Nvidia continued coverage from GTC Berlin. Nvidia posted a look back at the highlights, with Jensen Huang on stage showing how AI is taking shape across Europe, from AI factories and agents to robotics and healthcare.

sections.headline: Quiet on AI fronts
sections.reaction: Labs were quiet on new AI developments.
paragraphs: Google was quiet on the AI fronts overnight. No major new model or research posts in the window.

sections.headline: Overnight picture
sections.dek: Static fire stands out on a quieter day.
paragraphs: That is the overnight picture. A quieter day outside of the Super Heavy static fire. Have a good day.
